dependencies.name: obsidian-mcp-server
dependencies.purpose: Bundled via .mcp.json; provides read/write/search/tag/frontmatter operations against Obsidian's Local REST API. Requires Obsidian running with the Local REST API plugin enabled and an OBSIDIAN_API_KEY env var.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Most commands (vault-research, vault-connect, vault-recall, vault-capture, vault-daily, vault-search, vault-align) can't reach the vault at all — there's no offline/file-only fallback documented for the MCP-backed operations.

replacement.suggestion: read and write vault files directly with raw file I/O instead of the REST API
replacement.warning: the MCP server already handles link resolution, frontmatter, and plugin-aware writes that raw file I/O bypasses — risking broken wikilinks or corrupted frontmatter. Enabling the Local REST API plugin is far less risk than hand-rolling vault writes.

dependencies.name: Obsidian CLI
dependencies.purpose: The `obsidian` command (v1.12.4+), preferred over raw file I/O for terminal vault operations because it respects plugins, templates, and link resolution.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Commands that shell out to `obsidian <verb>` fail; only the MCP-server-backed operations (where coverage overlaps) remain available.

replacement.suggestion: use raw file I/O against the vault directory instead of the CLI
replacement.warning: raw file writes skip Obsidian's own plugin/template/link-resolution pipeline, risking the exact corruption the CLI exists to avoid — register the CLI instead (Settings → General → Command line interface).

dependencies.name: Defuddle
dependencies.purpose: npm package (`npm install -g defuddle`) powering the `defuddle` web-clipping/article-extraction skill.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The defuddle skill can't extract clean article content from a URL; every other vault workflow is unaffected.

replacement.suggestion: copy-paste article text manually instead of clipping
replacement.warning: Defuddle already handles boilerplate stripping and content extraction across arbitrary page layouts; a manual copy-paste loses that and has to be redone per site.

dependencies.name: qmd (+ qmd@qmd plugin)
dependencies.purpose: Local vector-embedding semantic search (BM25/vector/hybrid) for /vault-search, /vault-connect, and /vault-recall.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Documented graceful fallback — all three commands automatically use MCP/CLI keyword search instead of semantic search when qmd isn't available.

replacement.suggestion: keep using the plugin's own MCP/CLI keyword-search fallback
replacement.warning: this isn't a case for a custom reimplementation — the keyword-search fallback already is the intended non-qmd path. Installing qmd only upgrades to semantic search; it doesn't close a gap that needs a DIY replacement.

dependencies.name: Python 3
dependencies.purpose: Runs the standard-library-only evidence-bound compiled knowledge engine shared by Claude Code and Codex.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The knowledge-compiler skill and /vault-compile command are unavailable; ordinary vault capture, search, linking, and health workflows still work.

replacement.suggestion: install a current Python 3 runtime and invoke the bundled script with python3
replacement.warning: do not replace the deterministic engine with model-written hashing, policy, or transaction logic; that would break host parity and provenance guarantees.
